lines.text: Priya plans her first Banff trip around one photo: Moraine Lake at sunrise.
Then she reads the fine print.
Moraine Lake Road is closed to personal vehicles all year. No parking, no exceptions.
Plan on the Parks Canada shuttle from the Lake Louise Park and Ride,
and book it on the official Parks Canada site the day seats open in spring.
Priya gets her seat, and her sunrise.
Save this before you plan Banff.
